title: Hootenanny

services.name: Private Lessons
services.desc: each week, kids will sing, jam, dance, dress up, and explore instruments including piano, ukulele, drums, and more through playful, hands-on music-making. Rock Club is all about the fun of being in a band-think dance parties, rock-star costume play, instrument crafting, musical games, group jams, and plenty of chances to take the stage. Along the way, kids naturally build rhythm, listening skills, confidence, creativity, teamwork, and a strong musical foundation. Throughout the semester, we’ll also welcome Guest Student Artists-older Hootenanny musicians and talented local middle and high school students-who will perform, jam with the group, and show our youngest musicians just how many
